channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: PS5 sells out across major retailers in GTA VI's first Black Friday week
item.description: PS5 consoles have reportedly sold out at major US retailers, including Amazon and PlayStation Direct, less than a week after GTA VI's launch.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping heads into Thanksgiving with $148 million in five days
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel reached $148.2 million in North America by Tuesday and is expected to lead the holiday weekend.

item.title: Nvidia reportedly halts AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
item.description: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to stop shipping AI servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, the FT reports.

item.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
item.description: The FCC approved SpaceX's proposed Starmind network of up to one million satellites for computing in low Earth orbit.

item.title: Sony says over 39 million PS5 players tried GTA VI in its first four days
item.description: Sony says more than 39 million unique PS5 players played GTA VI from November 19 to 22, setting a PlayStation concurrent-player record.

item.title: 1Password says hackers took some customer data and source code
item.description: 1Password says an attacker used an employee's GitHub account to reach backend systems and took names and emails of some customers.

item.title: Pentagon officials reportedly discussed wartime law to return Huang to Nvidia
item.description: Pentagon officials discussed using the Defense Production Act to press Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang, the Washington Post reports.

item.title: 42 state attorneys general fight Character.AI's plan to auction user data
item.description: A group of 42 state attorneys general opposes Character.AI's plan to auction data from more than 21 million US accounts.

item.title: Focker-In-Law opens for Thanksgiving, with forecasts near $35 million
item.description: The fourth Meet the Parents film opened on Wednesday, with five-day forecasts between about $35 million and $45 million.

item.title: Disney's $200 million Hexed is tracking for a soft Thanksgiving start
item.description: Disney's animated Hexed opened on Wednesday with five-day forecasts of about $31 million to $40 million against a reported cost above $200 million.

item.title: EA uses AI to bring the late John Motson's voice to EA Sports FC 27
item.description: EA says it used AI and archive recordings to add the late commentator John Motson to EA Sports FC 27, with his family's permission.

item.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 designed proteins that bound to five targets in the lab
item.description: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models designed protein sequences using reasoning and code, and lab tests found binding to five targets.

item.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies at 65
item.description: Andy Taylor, the guitarist of Duran Duran, has died at 65 after a long battle with prostate cancer, JoBlo reports.

item.title: FinCEN takes systems offline after unauthorised access
item.description: The US Treasury's financial crimes unit says it is investigating unauthorised access to a limited subset of its systems.

item.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed to Saturday over bad weather
item.description: NBC's broadcast of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been moved to Saturday because of bad weather, TVLine reports.

item.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
item.description: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.

item.title: CBS says Nvidia sold top chips to two Chinese-owned California firms
item.description: A CBS News investigation says Nvidia sold some of its most advanced chips to two Chinese-owned California companies.

item.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to let Meta's Muse agent shop on Amazon
item.description: Amazon and Meta are said to be negotiating an end to Amazon's September block on Meta's Muse shopping agent.

item.title: Dario Amodei calls claims he would hand decisions to AI absurd
item.description: Anthropic's CEO rejected reporting that suggested he would cede human control to AI, and challenged Axios's account.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for an opening above $270 million
item.description: Early tracking points to a US opening of more than $270 million for Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday, JoBlo reports.

item.title: Microsoft says state hackers have adopted the ARTEX AI hacking tool
item.description: Microsoft says state-backed groups from China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, now use the AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX.

item.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
item.description: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.

item.title: OpenAI preprint claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
item.description: OpenAI posted a maths preprint claiming the exponent of matrix multiplication is 9/4, a result not yet independently checked.

item.title: ElevenLabs reportedly in early talks to raise at a $33 billion valuation
item.description: Voice AI firm ElevenLabs is said to be in early talks for a 2027 funding round at a $33 billion target valuation.

item.title: Team Cherry hosts Cherry Time! with Silksong news and a free DLC
item.description: Team Cherry streams a Cherry Time! event on November 27 with Hollow Knight: Silksong announcements, including the free Sea of Sorrow DLC.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
item.description: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.

item.title: US chip curbs stall billions in Asian data centre loans
item.description: Lenders are holding back data centre financing tied to ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent after new US chip curbs, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work limits, so heavy users may hit caps sooner
item.description: OpenAI says ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes will share one usage allowance, so people who use both heavily may hit limits sooner.

item.title: Rockstar UK staff vote 75% against union recognition
item.description: Staff at Rockstar's UK studios voted against union recognition sought with the IWGB union, with 75% voting no.

item.title: CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 stays multiplatform despite its Sony deal
item.description: After signing a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, CD Projekt says its games, including The Witcher 4, will stay multiplatform.

item.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages up to 14 days ahead
item.description: WhatsApp users can now schedule messages from 10 minutes to 14 days in advance in both group and individual chats.

item.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law banning the manufacture and sale of AI chatbot-powered toys in New York for five years.

item.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
item.description: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.

item.title: Ubisoft developers may have to justify not using AI, report says
item.description: Ubisoft may require its developers to explain decisions not to use generative AI, according to Vertical Slice.

item.title: Neuralink says the FDA approved a pivotal trial of its brain implant
item.description: Neuralink says it received FDA approval for its LINK Pivotal Study, a US trial of its brain-computer interface in people with ALS.

item.title: The Hunting Wives returns to Netflix with an eight-episode second season
item.description: Netflix released all eight episodes of The Hunting Wives' second season on Thanksgiving, TVLine reports.

item.title: US PS5 sales more than doubled year on year in the week before GTA VI
item.description: Circana data shows US PS5 hardware sales in the week ending November 14 were over 2.4 times the same week of 2025.

item.title: Nvidia agrees to pay $290 million to settle a 2018 crypto investor lawsuit
item.description: Nvidia will pay $290 million to settle a 2018 class action claiming it misled shareholders about crypto mining demand for its GPUs.

item.title: King Crimson's original drummer Michael Giles dies at 84
item.description: Michael Giles, the founding drummer of King Crimson, has died at 84, according to a report credited to Variety.

item.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
item.description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.

item.title: PS Plus adds Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 and two more games in December
item.description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and Amnesia: The Bunker join PlayStation Plus from December 1.

item.title: Ant Group releases Ling-3.2-air, an MIT-licensed multimodal model
item.description: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-air, a model that handles text, images and video, with open weights under the MIT licence.
